rationale: Champions out-earned our agent by $19k because ceasing all planting at Day 28 left our 10-hand workforce idle for 28+ hours while strictly excluding Carrots on Days 1-25 forfeited lucrative 2x-3x Town Shop contract premiums. We extend planting through Day 29 Hour 10 with fast-maturing Carrots, dynamically allocate seed purchases toward active Town Shop contract crops, and refine oracle monetization into multi-tier price triggers (16+ units at >=1.15x, smooth Day 29 liquidation) to maximize revenue without compromising midnight wage defense.
